[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]接受地图绘制委托，如果你正在制作mod，需要找人绘制地图，那么请联系我。[/color]
[color=#ffff00]Accept the entrustment of map drawing. If you are making mod and need to find someone to draw a map, please contact me.[/color]

[color=#00ff00]这是一个带有季节性变化的温室，尺寸有三种可选，背景有8种可选，包括玻璃颜色，玻璃窗颜色都是可以配置的
This is a greenhouse with seasonal changes, with three sizes available and eight backgrounds available, including glass color and window color that can be configured[/color]
[color=#ff00ff]
简单说一下config配置文件。
 GreenhouseSize: 修改温室尺寸
 BackdropAndFloor: 更换温室背景和地板
 Frame": 更改玻璃框颜色
 Glass": 更改玻璃颜色
 EnableGreenhouseDecorations": 启用温室里的装饰品
 EnableCellarDecorations": 启用温室酒窖里的装饰品[/color]

使用的玻璃框素材来自：(The glass frames paths used comes from:)
